title: Mock language model V2 shares array result indexing bug
summary: Vercel Agent Review on PR 15154 caught that MockLanguageModelV2 has the same off by one array indexing pattern as V3/V4: doGenerateCalls/doStreamCalls are pushed before selecting from array backed scripted results, so V2
body:
Vercel Agent Review on PR #15154 caught that MockLanguageModelV2 has the same off-by-one array indexing pattern as V3/V4: doGenerateCalls/doStreamCalls are pushed before selecting from array-backed scripted results, so V2 also needs length - 1 indexing. The focused mock-language-model test now covers V2, V3, and V4 generate/stream arrays.
Evidence: PR review comment from vercel bot on 2026-05-11; patch changed src/test/mock-language-model-v2.ts and expanded src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts. Targeted Vitest passed 8 tests after the update.
Verified by: pnpm --filter ai exec vitest --config vitest.node.config.js --run src/test/mock-language-model.test.ts src/test/mock-embedding-model.test.ts; pnpm --filter ai type-check; pnpm type-check:full; pnpm exec ultracite check targeted files
